name: Nvim development (prerelease) build
body:
```
NVIM v0.13.0-dev-1963+g9290926ccf
Build type: RelWithDebInfo
LuaJIT 2.1.1792527110
```

## Release notes

- [Changelog](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/9290926ccf55ba3f55e4b48f5b94cad403017688) (fixes + features)
- [News](./runtime/doc/news.txt) (`:help news` in Nvim)

## Install

### Windows

#### Zip

1. Download **nvim-win64.zip** (or **nvim-win-arm64.zip** for ARM)
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

#### MSI

1. Download **nvim-win64.msi** (or **nvim-win-arm64.msi** for ARM)
2. Run the MSI
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to [install `vcruntime*.dll`](https://neovim.io/doc/install/#windows).

### macOS (x86_64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### macOS (arm64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) [builds for older glibc](https://github.com/neovim/neovim-releases).

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (arm64)

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Other

- Install by [package manager](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/master/INSTALL.md#install-from-package)

name: v1.4.244
body:
## Faster diff view and editor, more languages, and better remote files 🌍

This release adds four interface languages, makes switching workspaces faster by preparing the one you’re about to open, and lets files on SSH hosts and paired servers play, save and open like local ones. It also brings smoother chat streaming, a faster prompt in new Windows terminals, steadier WSL terminals, and many fixes for dictation on the phone.

## The short version

- **Four new languages:** German, Russian, Turkish and Traditional Chinese join the language picker, and many more dialogs, menus and shortcuts are translated. German is machine-translated, and reviews from native speakers are welcome.
- **Faster workspace switching:** Hovering a workspace in the sidebar gets it ready, the workspaces next to the current one stay warm, and the switch itself does less work. Dragging a row never switches.
- **Remote files that work like local ones:** Play audio and video from SSH hosts and paired servers, save remote text files up to 50 MB, open folders too big for one reply as you scroll, and never open a remote binary as text.
- **Smoother chats:** Long replies stream with less stutter, @file suggestions keep up in large repositories, and multi-agent Codex chats no longer grow the local chat history to gigabytes. Claude chats can rewind to before your first message.
- **Steadier terminals:** New Windows terminals show their prompt right away instead of after about 3 seconds, closing or resizing a terminal no longer freezes the others on macOS and Linux, and WSL terminals keep their session and folder when their distro stops.
- **Browser:** Clear Google cookies from a profile when Google sign-in is stuck on an old account, import cookies from Vivaldi, and Orca no longer quits at startup on Windows and Linux when an extension’s helper window closes.
- **Fixes from the community:** Kimi K3 for commit messages, Devin Desktop in Open In, highlighting for Glimmer, CUDA, Groovy and shebang scripts, `orca worktree create --branch`, `~` in the worktree location, MacPorts tools on macOS, and the faster Windows prompt.

**Phone & web updates:** Dictation on the phone keeps recording through a reconnect, keeps your words through calls and busy taps, gives your audio back when it stops, and explains setup before asking for the microphone. The mobile setup page now sends iPhone installs to the App Store. Korean 10-Key typing, held terminal keys, pairing and file saves on the phone work better, and the phone does less work in the background.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Same terminal host as v1.4.243:** This release keeps v1.4.243’s terminal host instead of starting a fresh one, so terminals open when you update keep running and stay attached. A few terminal fixes run inside the terminal host, such as the faster prompt in new Windows terminals, closing or resizing a terminal without freezing others, and Ctrl+C in Codex. They take effect once the terminal host restarts, for example after you restart your computer.
- **SSH hosts and paired servers:** Some remote fixes need the host’s Orca server on this version too: saving large files, opening very large folders, theme answers for Codex in paired terminals, and copying from Codex started by hand (open a new remote shell after the host updates). Older servers keep their current behavior.
- **SSH workspaces:** Deleting a workspace on an SSH project now offers **Remove from Orca**, which leaves its files on the host untouched.
- **Workspace switching:** Workspaces still switch on click. Holding the next or previous workspace shortcut (Cmd+Shift+Up/Down) now moves the sidebar highlight and switches once you let go.
- **Worktree location:** A location starting with `~` now means your home folder. A `~` value saved by an earlier version is expanded on the next start.
- **Word separators:** Double-click always breaks words at spaces and tabs, even if your custom Word Separators setting leaves them out. The saved setting doesn’t change.
- **Mobile setup:** The iOS button, QR code and copied link on the mobile setup page point to the App Store. The TestFlight preview option is gone; Android still uses the APK link.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat (experimental)

*Smoother streaming, chat history that stays small, and Claude rewind from the first message.*

* Stream long chat replies with less stutter by parsing each block once by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34821
* Reuse typeset equations while chat replies stream by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34819
* Keep @file suggestions and Quick Open up with your typing in large repositories by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34820
* Stop multi-agent Codex chats from growing the local chat history to gigabytes and freezing the next launch by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35226
* Rewind a Claude chat to before your first message by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34239
* Show a chat’s saved permission mode, and let you change it, while its agent isn’t running by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34546
* Edit queued messages in place with the full chat composer, including images, skills and @files, on desktop and phone by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31180
* Show Hand Off in a chat tab’s top-right header, as terminals do by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34544
* Show pasted images as thumbnails you can enlarge in terminal-backed chats by @lurunzi in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22328
* Show and open `file:` images, and host images outside the workspace, in chats by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31781
* List OMP skills in the / menu as /skill:<name> by @pandudpn in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31999
* Show the full date and time when you hover a message’s timestamp by @VictorVow in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32051
* Close the chat naming error card when you open Settings from it by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34655
* Cut the work every open chat does on each update, easing lag with many chats by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34755
* Skip chat status rechecks when only the sidebar’s sort order changes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34781
* Keep rows the host removed out of chats on desktop and phone by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34996
* Say a chat’s working folder was deleted, instead of saying its CLI is missing by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35003
* Say when Orca couldn’t prepare a chat’s start, with the host’s error in Details by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35186
* Show a pending approval’s Allow and Deny on remote and phone clients after brief read failures by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35339

### Browser

*Clear Google cookies, import from Vivaldi, and browser and extension cleanup that frees memory.*

* Clear Google cookies from a browser profile in Settings, to fix a Google sign-in stuck on an old account by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34158
* Import cookies from Vivaldi on macOS, Windows and Linux by @dojineko in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/11449
* Open the exact address you type before a more-visited page on the same site by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34583
* Restart Find when a page’s browser view is replaced, so match counts and highlights stay right by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34738
* Stop an abandoned `orca eval` from blocking later commands on its page by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35284
* Let idle browser pages rest while Orca is hidden, and wake them for agent commands and screenshots by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34776
* Cap how much finished browser command output Orca keeps in memory by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34773
* Restore many saved browser profiles at startup with less work by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34748
* Resolve the system proxy once per browser profile at startup by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34977
* Drop a viewer that fails to join a live browser stream, and keep the working one connected by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34874
* Stop a closed DevTools from reopening when an earlier open finishes by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35035
* Stop browser automation startup cleanly when its page closes by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35093
* Keep cleanup working when you cancel opening a browser page by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35131
* Close a passkey account chooser when the page that asked for it goes away by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35132
* Close an SSH target’s browser profiles with one lookup by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34979
* Clean up a removed SSH host’s browser tabs without waiting on other hosts by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35024
* Close a deleted browser profile’s SSH connections by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35114
* Delete leftover browser storage at startup without opening its sessions by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35045
* Release an open extension install prompt when Orca reloads, so a retry works by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34931
* Drop an extension page’s event listeners when it reloads by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34942
* Drop an extension iframe’s listeners as soon as the frame goes away by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35011
* Limit ordinary extension visible-tab captures to two a second by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34962
* Release a deleted browser profile’s extension toolbar icons and badges by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34988
* Close an extension’s notifications when it’s turned off or removed by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35006
* Forget extension notifications the system failed to show by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35134
* Forget extension notifications once you click them by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35139
* Skip queued extension downloads after the extension unloads by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35047
* Release unloaded extensions’ click records by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35076
* Deliver extension frame events with less main-process work by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35079
* Stop downloading a Chrome Web Store package or icon Orca has rejected by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35158
* Expire abandoned extension menus after ten minutes by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35167

### Agent launch, status & accounts

*Disabled agents skip startup checks, “(CLI)” agents start as chats, and retained rows open their live panes.*

* Skip startup checks for agents you turned off in Settings by @Pr1p in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34832
* Start a “(CLI)” agent as a chat from the + menu by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34587
* Open existing chats and live retained panes from Dashboard cards and sidebar rows by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34650
* Open a retained agent row in the sidebar when its terminal is still running by @xiayuqin1 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20804
* Keep a stopped or failed turn’s verdict on Kanban cards, and show AI Vault background monitoring as such by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34649
* Keep the handoff confirmation visible, with a link back to the destination workspace by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34722
* Keep Claude’s extra-usage credit balance in the status bar through live usage updates by @lurunzi in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29759
* Keep Codex conversations across account switches in WSL by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34968
* Resume DeepSeek Harness (DSH) chats in the DSH engine, not the last engine you used by @jutaz in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27949
* Use a Qoder icon that stays visible in dark mode by @5unnyWind in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29038
* Stop a session you just deleted reappearing in Session History by @kassdinzheng123 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/27468
* Force English Git messages in copied skill install commands, so they work with a translated Git by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34599
* Give each control its own number after browser tab compaction in computer use on Linux and Windows by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35272
* Attach the exactly named iOS simulator before partial name matches by @bbingz in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34884

### Orchestration & CLI

*Worker worktrees name themselves, folder workspaces work in every command, and clearer CLI help.*

* Name a worker’s new worktree automatically, then rename it from the work, as for workspaces you create by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35363
* Deliver a coordinator’s message to a worker’s sub-team instead of refusing it by @lorenzozanee in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24974
* Start Muse workers on Linux, where its composer has no voice-input label by @j33pia in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25695
* Let scripts and orchestration messages send to a terminal while your phone controls it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34675
* Say `--takeover-legacy` doesn’t apply to ordinary Runs, instead of asking you to re-authenticate the terminal by @hsusul in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34284
* Name the Git branch with `orca worktree create --branch` by @1aifanatic in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26752
* Add `--agent-wait` to `orca worktree ps` to show which agents are waiting on a human by @ggbdpq in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24142
* Accept folder workspaces in every CLI command that takes a workspace by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35223
* Show a repo’s Git-created worktrees right after `orca repo set --external-worktree-visibility show` by @younghwan91 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32783
* Read `orca search --since` times in the UTC offset they carry by @agustin2606 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28329
* Strip hidden terminal control sequences from Linear text in CLI output by @SamuelAdigos in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31677
* Show a command group’s help for bare commands like `orca skills` instead of “Unknown command” by @Ehsan-hash in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34502
* List only the flags each CLI command takes in its help by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34598
* Explain automation prechecks, and that removing a folder workspace entry keeps its files by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34523

### Terminals

*A faster prompt in new Windows terminals, no freezes on close or resize, and file links that open from agent output.*

* Show the prompt in new Windows terminals right away instead of after about 3 seconds by @LeonYew-Ley in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34466
* Stop closing or resizing a terminal on macOS and Linux from freezing other terminals while Orca checks running processes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34603
* Stop Ctrl+C leaving Codex waiting two seconds, and keep late terminal replies out of the shell by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34723
* Stop worktree setup commands getting cut off while the shell starts by @Eotel in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25820
* Keep the terminal host and orcad running when the disk stalls while they write logs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34659
* Give the idle terminal host the same five-second exit deadline as every other shutdown by @Totoro-qaq in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29407
* Show the link popup for a file path in agent output even when the prose after it looks like a path by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34281
* Copy a file’s path from the terminal link popup by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21257
* Close a single-pane terminal tab from its right-click menu by @OriginalByteMe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31815
* Always break words at spaces and tabs on double-click, whatever your Word Separators setting by @kazuki-hanai in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28336
* Find MacPorts tools in /opt/local when Orca starts from the Dock by @hyein-cbio in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20146
* Free the drawing memory of terminals in hidden tabs by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34309
* Restore terminal history when a window reloads in the middle of reattaching by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34927
* Keep your newer copy in the clipboard after copying a large terminal selection by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35124
* Release terminal previews when their window reloads or crashes by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34863
* Fail terminal reveal requests right away when their window goes away by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35030

### SSH, WSL & remote servers

*Remote files that play, save and page like local ones, SSH workspaces you can remove, and WSL distros that stay stopped.*

* Play audio and video files from SSH hosts and paired servers in the editor by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35038
* Save text files up to 50 MB on WSL hosts and SSH servers by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35073
* Open very large folders on a remote server, loading more as you scroll by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35115
* Never open a binary file on a remote host as text, or download it in full to find out by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34877
* Cap very large remote search results, and say when a diff is too large instead of “Binary file changed” by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34882
* Offer Remove from Orca for SSH workspaces this app can’t delete, leaving files on the host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35271
* Keep an SSH host server’s own tabs on reload instead of older saved tabs from before it had one by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34901
* Allow a forced update or rollback of an SSH host whose terminals span two terminal host versions by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34664
* Let the new build name the terminal host versions an older SSH host can’t report, so its forced update goes through by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34908
* List an SSH host’s terminal agents again as soon as it reconnects by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35019
* Keep keys typed into a remote terminal while it reattaches after a switch by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34630
* Keep remote terminal input working after a failed viewport restore by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34716
* Copy from Codex started by hand in a remote shell to your own clipboard by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34715
* Answer a paired terminal’s theme questions with the viewer’s theme, so Codex matches your light or dark theme by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35340
* Keep a remote agent’s status in sync after it finishes or resumes from an approval by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34729
* Skip orcad’s startup self-check on an unchanged host after a start that worked, so Orca’s server starts sooner by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35064
* Start the terminal host as soon as orcad has its login environment by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35341
* Stop watching a removed paired host for reconnects by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34865
* Keep a WSL terminal’s session when its distro is shut down and started again by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35050
* Close one more gap where a restarted WSL distro lost a terminal’s session by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35133
* Reopen a WSL terminal in the folder you left when its distro stopped while Orca was closed by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35141
* Close a WSL terminal sooner after a clean `exit` by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35138
* Never restart a WSL distro you stopped because of a list taken while it was shutting down by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35143
* Keep background repo checks, PR refreshes and worktree scans from starting a stopped WSL distro by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34632
* Keep the sidebar’s orca.yaml checks from starting a stopped WSL distro by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35155
* Hide the setup-script card while the project’s WSL distro is stopped by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35163
* Stop the WSL agent-status helper after 5 quiet minutes, so its distro can stop by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35173
* Show Codex questions and finished child agents correctly in WSL terminals by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34724
* Keep WSL filenames with control characters from cutting file updates short by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34855
* Check a WSL skill install against just the installed skill, so it finishes sooner by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28750

### Source control & integrations

*Honest status when Git can’t read a workspace, clean Kimi output, and fewer GitHub requests.*

* Warn when Git can’t read a workspace’s status, with a Retry, instead of calling it clean by @SamuelAdigos in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28079
* Keep Kimi’s bullets and thinking lines out of generated commit messages, branch names and PR text by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34237
* Pick Kimi K3 for AI commit messages by @LosEcher in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/11386
* List PRs for private repos when gh is signed in with a GitHub App (ghu_) token by @bbingz in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34633
* Show the real error when closing or reopening a GitHub issue or GitLab MR fails, instead of reporting success by @zanmlakar in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28777
* Count gh pr and issue commands against GitHub’s GraphQL limit, so Orca backs off when it runs out by @zanmlakar in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28778
* Recognize ssh.bitbucket.org remotes in Source Control and build working PR links by @ejunker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30808
* Retry brief Linear read failures and keep the network cause by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35074
* Save GitHub REST quota by revalidating unchanged PR lookups by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34759
* Reuse loaded profiles for PR mentions, saving a GitHub request per PR view by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/34771
* Check PR refresh owners by ID instead of listing every window by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/35015

body:
## What's Changed
* fix(agent-status): keep Codex's hidden title-thread prompt off the sidebar heading by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33746
* test: remove redundant browser, runtime and secret registry coverage by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33767
* test: remove redundant configuration, shortcut and recovery coverage by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33770
* fix(runtime): keyboard tab switches tell a paired server which tab this desktop shows by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33761
* fix(agent-resume): resume Claude sessions at their own effort level by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33765
* test: remove 29 low-value renderer suites by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33772
* feat(connector): wire contract between Orca and the cloud connector service (inert) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33670
* fix(wsl): keep a UNC drive-folder project's worktrees under their saved names by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33706
* refactor(cloud): share push's database layer as a package by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33714
* refactor(renderer): group agent-status records and reducers by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33665
* feat(connector): connector service skeleton that checks auth-service tokens by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33723
* feat(tools): resize the PTY mid-capture with --resize-at by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33781
* feat(connector): inbox with held long poll, two confirmations and expiry, on connector tokens by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33734
* fix(codex): resume a thread with the permissions it was last given, not Orca's launch flag by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33460
* Prevent retained chat panes from jumping before anchors resolve by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33788
* fix(agent-resume): keep a background agent launch's flags when it is resumed by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33776
* test: remove low-value predicates, inventories and helper echoes by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33778
* Fix native chat hover colors for live theme changes by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33791
* perf(daemon): skip drain-waiter filter when none are pending by @ctolkien in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30996
* build(deps): bump vite 8.3.5, oxlint 1.89.0, oxlint-tsgolint 7.0.2005 by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33794
* test: remove low-value inventories, passthroughs and redundant cases by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33796
* fix(agent-awake): warn once while the Linux lid sleep assertion keeps failing by @brynnclaw in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24839
* fix(computer-use): probe Linux editables via get_editable_text_iface by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/10586
* fix(updater): probe latest-linux-arm64.yml on Linux arm64 by @fettpl in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18339
* test: remove low-value renderer predicates and wrapper suites by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33811
* refactor: colocate task page composition hooks by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33808
* perf(lint): skip JS plugin rules on files that cannot match (lint:js-plugins 17s → 4s) by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33813
* fix(computer-use): send correct named keys and hotkey letters on Linux by @AlgoraAndrew in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22494
* Unify terminal starts under one host operation by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32076
* fix(worktrees): an unqualified id two hosts share resolves to nothing, not the first copy by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33818
* fix(native-chat): end a start at once on agent answers that can never succeed by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33685
* fix(native): pin node-pty cfset*speed with legacy baud codes for glibc 2.42+ by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33803
* Give native chats a fresh automatic name after /clear by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32287
* fix(agents): re-list a host's terminal agents when contact returns by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33816
* perf(devex): parallel pnpm lint (169s → 50s), capped typecheck threads, fresh shard timings by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33817
* fix(chat-rename): skip invisible legacy tab names during rename migration by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33678
* Revert "fix(native-chat): preserve Claude approval choices across model changes" by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33823
* Stop workers from taking over the Run they work for by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29008
* perf(mobile): a streaming reply re-renders only the rows that changed by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23840
* perf(build): cap Rolldown threads (−24% build CPU); don't block pnpm dev on the pairing web build by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33828
* fix(native-chat): remove misleading usage-limit Continue action by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33392
* Fix Codex goal Stop and selected model settings by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33631
* test(vitest): run-scoped temp dir, removed on exit, so test fixtures stop leaking into /tmp by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33834
* fix(terminal): repaint local TUIs over the hidden-output loss banner by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33835
* fix(daemon): give each macOS resolver health probe a unique clientId by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33833
* perf(wsl): relay orcad sockets through bash instead of a Node bridge by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33820
* perf(orcad): retire an idle session scanner after a minute on host servers by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33845
* perf(dev): −1.2 GB idle RSS per pnpm dev instance (Rolldown threads + mimalloc purge) by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33836
* test(vitest): stop orphaned node-runtime workers when Vitest is killed (150s+ → 53ms) by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33848
* fix(preflight): detect Grok CLI installed only in ~/.grok/bin by @brynnclaw in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25324
* fix(terminal): answer queries in output a paused paired view discards by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33783
* fix(terminal): a pane moved to a new tab stays moved on paired servers by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33027
* fix(wsl-host): tie each WSL host record to its pairing key (R31) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29832
* test: remove low-value renderer suites and redundant shared cases by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33819
* fix(terminal): typing held for a starting agent still arms recovery when its connect hangs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33865
* fix(agent-awake): warn once and back off when the sleep assertion keeps failing by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33841
* perf(daemon): cap the terminal daemon's young generation (−51 MB idle, −75 MB after bursts) by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33837
* perf(terminal): relax idle agent inspection for local POSIX shell panes (−46 MB daemon, −75% idle CPU) by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33829
* perf(build): keep bundled scripts one-byte in V8 (−24 MB idle) by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33786
* perf(editor): stop Monaco's TS/JS worker when no TS/JS file is open (−38 MB V8) by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33810
* fix(runtime): stop a crash-zeroed server list from blocking every server save by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33864
* fix(terminal): don't rewrite live bytes a renderer hydration seed already painted by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33880
* test: remove low-value renderer helper and presentation tests by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33876
* feat(serve): keep macOS serve out of the Dock and opt in to the GPU on Linux by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33878
* refactor: colocate task page list presentation rules by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33830
* fix(build): pin the native SwiftPM build system for the computer-use universal binary by @eatmoreduck in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/21146
* fix(ssh): refuse a second Orca server from a host cloned with the same machine-id by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33775
* perf(ci): shorten preflight's serial tail (~24s median), parallel ratchets, allow 2–10 unit shards by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33887
* fix(github): send issue bodies to gh over stdin instead of argv by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25215
* fix(open-in): strip AppImage runtime env from editors launched from Orca on Linux by @SamuelAdigos in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31675
* fix(automations): step schedule scans by calendar day so DST changes don't skip dates by @ImcLiuQian in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/19086
* fix(orchestration): keep the transcript handle open when a forward page fills by @kaznowski in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/32894
* fix(browser): accept an empty --value in fill and select commands by @2sumtech in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/16030
* fix(telemetry): send only an errno code, not the raw error message, in agent_hook_install_failed by @brynnclaw in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/25287
* fix(notifications): use the real macOS default sound for the System notification option by @Ethereal49 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26321
* fix(shell): resolve VS Code CLI from standard app installs when `code` is not on PATH by @bbingz in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/14010
* fix(build): keep index.js source map aligned with the bootstrap banner by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33899
* docs: stop promising cross-worktree split panes and Shift-Enter split in Jump Palette by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33902
* refactor: colocate task page PR presentation rules by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33890
* fix(drops): keep remote drops out of git and say why drops or file opens fail by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33831
* perf(lint): one ast-grep scan for the lint gate and the flaky-test ratchet (11s → 6s) by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33903
* fix(diff): keep the collapsed section's header in view in View all diff by @innocarpe in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/24466
* fix(process-table): pin macOS ps to en_US.UTF-8 so lstart and argv parse under any locale by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33898
* fix(editor): reload open tabs on external changes when Windows paths are spelled differently by @VXNCXNX in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/14812
* fix(memory): resource panel shows Activity Monitor's footprint on macOS and counts the terminal daemon by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33901
* fix(wsl-host): keep the bridge port across app restarts so the host isn't re-paired by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33109
* fix(cli): show orphaned state in human-readable terminal list/show output by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33910
* test(wsl): cover the bash bridge's argv, backpressure, fallbacks and cleanup by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33907
* fix(terminal): keep find-bar highlights when navigating with Cmd+G / Cmd+Shift+G by @AntonioKL in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/18844
* fix(ai-vault): delete a server-hosted session on the server that owns it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33906
* docs(settings): describe the GitHub integration as the local gh CLI login, not OAuth by @eatmoreduck in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/26609
* refactor(task-page): colocate cross-provider composition owners by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/33913

name: v0.8.216
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.216

Released on 2026-10-29.

This release carries every change from v0.8.215, which never reached npm. iPhone Safari keeps every take's sound, multi-worker renders land each frame in place, and encoding runs faster.

## Features

- **Telemetry:** Identify signed-in CLI users by their HyperFrames user id, and say signed-in usage is not anonymous ([1c3fcf4d2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1c3fcf4d237d031107baa6a5646b5bb1ee82cc2a), [#6703](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6703)).
- **Producer:** Report which element set the film length ([3ca1005a8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3ca1005a81e76565a69d5874371c857321b66d59), [#6689](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6689)).

## Fixes

- **Player:** iPhone Safari keeps every take's sound after the first seconds of an edit ([48ba0e5b2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/48ba0e5b2bf91fc816adc0a7769d7344091aa5d7), [#6724](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6724)).
- **AWS Lambda:** The release ffmpeg build falls back to verified mirrors when a source host is down ([f0665f718](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f0665f71813278b0e6999df68de691e51d52679d), [#6728](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6728)).
- **CLI:** A failed render names its failure code for the Desktop app ([ba8ffffa0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ba8ffffa0b5695d207cc89949e90e5902839fd67), [#6725](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6725)).
- **CLI:** A snapshot still shows what playback shows, whatever other times are asked for ([cf1589242](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cf15892425245da96dc43d858a7478031533d2f1), [#6720](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6720)).
- **CLI:** The lint summary points at hyperframes lint, not a flag only render takes ([98a28cc4b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/98a28cc4b2919f1c8418d2cb61bafc66ec9ccb31), [#6723](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6723)).
- **Ci:** Skills sync steps past the five hidden ClawHub versions blocking it ([49e031230](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/49e0312300d6c049b19eb8435930f980621a993f), [#6713](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6713)).
- **CLI:** An unknown command like search says which command does that ([bb4deb801](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bb4deb8014a8457425c2e6e4a8619969514824ea), [#6710](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6710)).
- **CLI:** Check says how many browser-playable copies are done while it makes them ([2f8c4b1da](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2f8c4b1dafaebc26f4dcfe6252312faf39ff9d89), [#6712](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6712)).
- **Core:** A multi-worker or chunked render lands every frame where an in-order render does ([fa9acbd73](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fa9acbd7399b7cd5ca9940399d9066bb33d96973), [#6707](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6707)).
- **CLI:** Check says a lint error is why the browser pass was skipped ([11312b359](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/11312b359b18c07911615656b95f48c7d8d82fea), [#6709](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6709)).
- **CLI:** Capture names the network's proxy when it refuses the connection to the site ([f0c5db6ea](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f0c5db6ea266a5a96907e66ef762e0f6dd85d623), [#6706](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6706)).
- **CLI:** Check waits as long as the --timeout it was given before it counts as idle ([6c1765933](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6c17659337d50b578c5c54ae716308a13eb2c822), [#6705](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6705)).
- **CLI:** Audio windows read beats off the whole clip; beats snap to the signal and mark silence ([4fa5f5451](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4fa5f54519150566b8ef706f60c05ff13c903423), [#6692](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6692)).
- **Producer:** A BeginFrame capture that draws no first frame in 20 s switches to screenshot ([a5496b188](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a5496b1887950777b78ed5ac2bff3505961cb5fe), [#6701](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6701)).
- **CLI:** Media-treatment --capability preset finds the presets area ([cfa653af4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cfa653af4d0f95d751286fb25c8d38bdb56ef663), [#6700](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6700)).
- **CLI:** A Windows render no longer prints taskkill's already-exited message ([ac449555f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ac449555f4607ea65895628164cb2835afdd0ce5), [#6698](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6698)).
- **CLI:** Snapshot reads https video in the Desktop app instead of failing at ffprobe ([0620067eb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0620067eb096fee9b6748efb9421d852d540cbf6), [#6699](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6699)).
- **CLI:** A stopped model download resumes on the next run instead of starting over ([81959201f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/81959201f0acb2e265e4d8c30daa89ffc1c9607d), [#6694](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6694)).
- **CLI:** Media-treatment finds an area by the name its overview prints ([2c3d1e07f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2c3d1e07fe63d4a2d67d63a3e29d4ad73e291d8e), [#6675](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6675)).
- **Engine:** Downloads refuse hosts that resolve to private addresses ([9830059bd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9830059bdb08adbab473d059d1b6db2230a5bb15), [#6571](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6571)).
- **CLI:** Check no longer reports outline text as not painted ([9f65efb19](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9f65efb19c3f435ef58f6fc81c6909d2a3920f8a), [#6693](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6693)).
- **CLI:** Beats --json answers with no track when the composition has no music ([ec10aae54](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ec10aae54fd3bcadaebb7e935a2b53d788fee074), [#6690](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6690)).
- **Core:** Graded media honors object-position vertically instead of mirroring it ([aa4a71fe4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/aa4a71fe417401b5d8a69cff36f56319defd3ba7), [#6691](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6691)).
- **Studio:** Audio keeps playing after a timeline move or trim in a static composition ([9aa6346a7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9aa6346a779328f1c0963ec3d37b856ad164c969), [#6428](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6428)).
- **Engine:** A render from an app that bundles the engine stamps the engine's version ([cdc86117c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cdc86117c7ffa6bf087017035ea17149b98303da), [#6686](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6686)).
- **Studio:** An undo or redo counts as a preview change from its key, not from its reload ([710314c15](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/710314c15e11bb1f49cd83117f42b3cf2b2fc62e), [#6683](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6683)).
- **Producer:** A capture that landed every frame is not failed for the work after its last frame ([067cbf7ac](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/067cbf7acf55e54517650b5ade24cfa352806c04), [#6674](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6674)).
- **CLI:** Check no longer treats a transparent canvas as covering the frame ([203a08dd7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/203a08dd7c1d4856e04e6a1288915a4b6f5fa2f6), [#6681](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6681)).
- **Core:** Grade groups resolve per composition; freeze frames keep their lane ([c569760a7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c569760a7a7c96df6540d53bbfe4670225ae140e), [#6685](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6685)).

## Performance

- **Engine:** Encode high quality with the x264 fast preset ([be05c8693](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/be05c86932be215ec70621dc568af96415555fa0), [#6640](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6640)).
- **Engine:** Size render workers from measured heap and the container's CPU quota ([cd003e201](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cd003e201051317234598bcf1c70cfed4770613f), [#6641](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6641)).
- **Producer:** The audio true-peak check seeks to each segment instead of decoding up to it ([c2cde2fb6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c2cde2fb624ba5a311615574dff822a41f61ea96), [#6672](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6672)).

## Docs & Examples

- **CLI:** Say which audio probes run once per file ([5d437d5ee](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5d437d5eecd65f05daa4ff451ebb85b71f88fdb9), [#6731](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6731)).
- **CLI:** List check's audio findings with severity, trigger and fix ([fa97f9d4b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fa97f9d4b7b4f401560dcc3e642267e953a2a89e), [#6730](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6730)).

## Catalog

- **Skills:** The registry skill says its commands are catalog and add ([1428f8768](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1428f876899557a4fe4448a6ac327ff503be53f5), [#6680](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6680)).

## Internal

- One regression shard writes the test image cache ([74f323473](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/74f3234736ad87568831ed51c34a7e289dc668e6), [#6729](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6729)).
- **CLI:** The publish abort test checks the summary hint is absent ([077de9bfe](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/077de9bfe9f248c0807ba2c7f78d1514adf85bc6), [#6726](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6726)).

## Full changelog

# HyperFrames v0.8.214

Released on 2026-10-28.

A lane of clips can now share one colour grade, so grading a camera means editing one element. A grade can also be baked into a 3D LUT that matches the preview.

## Features

- **Core:** Grade groups grade a whole lane from one hf-color-group ([09b129047](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/09b12904748b71ab1777d335f20026d45d6944ca), [#6678](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6678)).
- **Core:** Bake a colour grade into a 3D LUT (.cube) ([c9017f45f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c9017f45f4b8c38e11396a70a3d05d3432c58b48), [#6679](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6679)).

## Fixes

- **Studio:** A tab's save keeps the newer video version another tab recorded ([348971c22](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/348971c22285421a062ab5df45ad94bb4680bf9c), [#6682](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6682)).

name: v0.8.213
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.213

Released on 2026-10-28.

Videos that start late in a clip now render every frame the preview shows. Fonts in a linked stylesheet are bundled, website capture stops on its own, and check and snapshot read each file once.

## Fixes

- **Core:** Bundled fonts in a linked stylesheet or a font shorthand are seen by the bundler ([67c7ec27d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/67c7ec27d9978076137459d471be936a993e22df), [#6665](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6665)).
- **CLI:** Website capture ends with what it has instead of running until it is killed ([5b5633fbb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5b5633fbbc2e77ee689dfe121c11c4adc4b31777), [#6662](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6662)).
- **Core:** A preview media load that fails is reported, not swallowed ([cf627a861](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cf627a86193808a7d9dcddf4ca903a898914ea8b), [#6666](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6666)).
- **CLI:** Snapshot decodes each video once for all the times it shows ([cd3b90d1e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cd3b90d1edde62c3181800ee469b425edd32889f), [#6667](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6667)).
- **CLI:** Check treats text inside a closed details element as not rendered ([a1733f4e4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a1733f4e40e7e60025b6e481be18309d2b5bd87f), [#6669](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6669)).
- **CLI:** Check probes each audio file once, however many clips are cut from it ([8fe0ce660](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8fe0ce660bd8be77d70adf4ac10d699c3782c4a1), [#6654](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6654)).
- **Studio:** A timeline edit on a clip the file lacks says how the clip was looked up ([40c28e10d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/40c28e10dbca440c9707ff8f66b0425cd78913af), [#6661](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6661)).
- **CLI:** A late teardown error no longer turns a finished command into exit 1 ([5a9fdd524](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5a9fdd524b3303c23182176910a28201821819c9), [#6659](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6659)).
- **Engine:** Late-starting MP4 and WebM videos render every frame the preview shows ([437784038](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/437784038b10ef9dc1563a25865acae93cce3b2a), [#6664](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6664)).
- **Audio:** A sound is voice only with a voice-range pitch, judged on the whole clip ([1df31d871](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1df31d8717578e31d4c80c194410bbc65783ff6f), [#6653](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6653)).

## Internal

- **Producer:** Stall test no longer waits a real second for the progress flush ([6486d5802](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6486d580218a57838b8bd37ab66e200c127acfe4), [#6658](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6658)).
- **Engine:** The multi-chunk encode test gets the 30 s the other ffmpeg tests have ([4db1214e7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4db1214e7df8bb56328da5db75e60eac3f57020c), [#6663](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6663)).

## Full changelog

name: v5.3.3
body:
This one cleans up the band. On Team, Enterprise and managed machines the warning on your first prompt is gone, and the band shows your model and session name again. In VS Code it stays on one line, other plugins' commands no longer print under ponytail's name, and the noisy "duplicate?" hint is gone.


## What's Changed
* fix(band): show the level again after /clear and /resume by @timofeevAV in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1161
* fix(map): raise the git ls-files buffer so large repos keep tracked files by @HyperionBurn in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1156
* ci: run agentic benchmark selftest in test workflow by @ml-lubich in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1154
* docs: clarify Cursor mode state scope by @Boulea7 in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1135
* fix(codex): small composer icon instead of the 554 KB logo by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1164
* fix(hooks): 15 s hook timeout so a slow node start on Windows keeps its output by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1165
* fix(hooks): give the codebase map 3 s so a slow Windows start keeps it by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1166
* fix(bench): wait for the killed todo server before the workdir cleanup by @devohmycode in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1116
* fix(band): find the transcript without a classic hook by @trhinehart-attentive in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1242
* fix(band): watch only /clear, /resume and /branch, so other plugins' output is not labelled ponytail by @ph3on1x in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1291
* fix(band): size the row to bodyColumns only in the terminal by @lelmarir in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1302
* fix(band): drop the duplicate? hint, count only project files, tighter details view by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1305

name: v1.3.2
body:
### Patch Changes

- [#1194](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1194) [`b645f47`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/b645f47de3e17ed3bf60586c9bebb8092e0f79fd) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - `ask-matt` now reads a skill's `SKILL.md` before stating what it does or recommending a step be skipped, instead of trusting its own one-line summaries ([#614](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/614)).

- [#1304](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1304) [`5beb35b`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/5beb35b040e3de97e54fa9e386d7e42d15c295c2) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - `chief-of-staff` now keeps its memory in an LLM wiki (an `index.md` plus one page per topic, maintained through ingest, query and lint) and writes it as a historical record: every claim is dated, and every claim about code cites the commit it was true at.

- [#1208](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1208) [`3da8c01`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/3da8c01116264675eeefbd6e9d59c734de9095cc) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - `code-review` now searches the repo for standards files and always hands `CODING_STANDARDS.md` / `CONTRIBUTING.md` to the Standards sub-agent ([#1065](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/1065)), runs both sub-agents in the foreground and uses their returned reports ([#1073](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/1073)), and resolves the issue tracker through the provided tracker doc instead of a hard-coded path ([#937](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/937)).

- [#1209](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1209) [`f3fc563`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/f3fc5632f401156837ee3872f14fe33ccf1024ea) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - `diagnosing-bugs` Phase 5 now has the agent `diff` a forced mutation against a pristine copy before trusting the red, so an edit that silently changed nothing can't pass as a failing test ([#955](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/955)).

- [#1187](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1187) [`e0efb6e`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/e0efb6e7435ebb420d8a25d6816ed1ebaa2d23d2) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - Fixed the GitHub tracker template's external-PR listing, which failed on `authorAssociation` ([#468](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/468), thanks @lofi-coding). Re-run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` to refresh `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.

- [#1169](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1169) [`59db609`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/59db609eb1e18aaf59b63284d0e52255aff0c63c) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - The GitHub issue tracker template that `setup-matt-pocock-skills` writes now tells agents to file issues only into the user's own repo, never into `mattpocock/skills`, and to check the target repo before the first `gh issue create`. Agents working in a clone or fork of this repo had filed their specs and tickets here ([#541](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/541) to [#550](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/550)).

- [#1193](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1193) [`95249b0`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/95249b0b49782349740fd9b8c6ce32b4e59e497a) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - `grilling` words each question so "yes" accepts the recommended answer, so agreeing never means answering "no" ([#706](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/706)).

- [#1184](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1184) [`4f4e943`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/4f4e9433bbb7c4957ef33b1ea26686fb7c2a4cf4) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - `handoff` now names where the OS temp directory is (`$TMPDIR`, else `/tmp`; `%TEMP%` on Windows), so agents stop guessing ([#272](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/272)).

- [#1189](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1189) [`e48341a`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/e48341a3d412cfeba4b9a79d3fd0331fc376ba82) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - `implement` now calls the Skill tool for `tdd` and `code-review` instead of bare `/skill` prose, matching [#878](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/878).

- [#1196](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1196) [`6d6a5b9`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/6d6a5b9072f47ee7ba1d972d8ce0ee98b7ed4394) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - `implement` fetches a passed ticket reference from the issue tracker and states its title before starting, asking when the reference is ambiguous ([#700](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/700)).

- [#1228](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1228) [`ed0de59`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/ed0de59eb5de8c2730a650cc69f588ffa64c1040) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - `setup-matt-pocock-skills` now wires up a git remote before writing a GitHub/GitLab tracker that nothing can reach ([#1201](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/1201)), and offers to `git mv` a legacy `CONTEXT.md` / `CONTEXT-MAP.md` to its `GLOSSARY` name ([#1176](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/1176)). The GitHub template comments before closing ([#873](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/873)), reads a PR's body as well as its comments ([#1138](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/1138)), moves **Blocking** into Conventions with the native `gh` flags ([#855](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/855)), and names the command that counts open blockers ([#1118](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/1118)). The GitLab template lists MRs with `-O json` and names the frontier query's command ([#1143](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/1143)). Re-run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` to refresh `docs/agents/`.

- [#1197](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1197) [`5b7cade`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/5b7cade4d68947f34dae71326a0ce89f09e22c9c) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - `setup-matt-pocock-skills` now creates missing triage labels on GitHub/GitLab ([#616](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/616)), fixes the GitLab template's `glab` commands ([#635](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/635)), reads GitHub issues with `--json` so labels and body come through ([#733](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/733)), and names the "Label in our tracker" column in `triage-labels.md` ([#801](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/801)). Re-run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` to refresh `docs/agents/`.

- [#1341](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1341) [`7739eae`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/7739eaed7f8f3915437a8def198a6d0d7206dbc7) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - Skills that dispatch subagents (`implement-spec`, `code-review`, `codebase-design`, `improve-codebase-architecture`, `wayfinder`, `research`, `grilling`, `chief-of-staff`) now say to start each one with a fresh context window rather than forking the current conversation, which some harnesses (Codex) do by default and which throws away the clean context a subagent exists for.

- [#1192](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1192) [`3f59913`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/3f599139104dfceabc7754eeb91319802f85e042) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - `tdd` now gives each proposed seam a one-line note on what it catches and what it misses, so choosing between seams is no longer a guess ([#607](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/607)).

- [#1183](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1183) [`ad5400b`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/ad5400b930b297b0c0cb231ff1ffe42a7da666aa) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - `teach` quizzes vary which position holds the correct answer ([#611](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/611)).

- [#1183](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1183) [`ad5400b`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/ad5400b930b297b0c0cb231ff1ffe42a7da666aa) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - `teach` writes its workspace to the directory you ran it in, not the skill folder ([#377](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/377)).

- [#1188](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1188) [`cffab50`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/cffab50350e3d96688f63f890f4d7ca0e6007cfe) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - `to-tickets` makes each ticket a sub-issue of its source issue (the GitHub tracker template now gives the command), and omits `## Blocked by` when blockers are native edges. Re-run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` to refresh `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`. Thanks @richardwhatever ([#554](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/554)) and @adamslowe ([#262](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/262)).

- [#1181](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1181) [`8295b8e`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/8295b8e10d4cdb6cce772a56dda7b7c37075074d) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - `wayfinder` no longer labels maps or tickets `ready-for-agent` ([#518](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/518)), writes cross-references only with real issue ids ([#507](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/507)), opens no PR from research branches ([#576](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/576)), and resolves each ticket as the type its label names ([#625](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/625)). Thanks @jcwayne, @baob, @rynz and @sponge-b0b.

- [#1237](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1237) [`49dd158`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/49dd158d1076134a641b33efb035946536778336) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - `wizard` template fixes: `_existing` decodes a double-quoted `.env` value, so Enter-keeps-current no longer stores the quotes ([#1220](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/1220)); stages run inside `run_wizard`, so editing the script mid-run can't kill it ([#1142](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/1142)); `_clear` falls back to ANSI when `tput clear` fails ([#1081](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/1081)); `write_env` sets the shell variable too ([#1041](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/1041)); drop the unused `RED` ([#1003](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/1003)).

- [#1198](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/pull/1198) [`868c4cf`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/868c4cf20cb7e08bc805c388ff1f305dbedd261a) Thanks [@mattpocock](https://github.com/mattpocock)! - `wizard` template fixes: `ask` uses Readline so arrow keys move the cursor ([#741](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/741)); `write_env` single-quotes values so spaces, `#`, `$` and quotes survive `source` and dotenv ([#770](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/770)); `open_url` prints the open-it-yourself warning when no browser opener exists ([#774](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/774)); `write_env` writes through a symlinked `.env` and keeps an existing file's mode ([#811](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/811)); `ask` and `ask_secret` fail at EOF instead of looping ([#852](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/issues/852)).

name: Reasonix Studio v2.55.0
body:
本版新增可自定义的对话宽度百分比，调整设置页与安装升级的体验，并修复 Windows 沙箱下 Git Bash 不可用等多处问题。

## 新增

- 「外观 → 尺寸 → 行宽」新增自定义百分比，可在 30–100% 之间按 1% 调整，对话与输入框一起生效，不影响已有预设。关联 #14649 fixed in #14667 by @lancy69。

## 变更

- 设置页顶部的标题块（分类名、设置项数量）去掉了，导航已标明位置，第一张卡片直接出现在页面顶部。关联 #14625。
- 已安装的程序位于项目文件夹内时，「用其他程序打开」会列出它并标明原因，悬停可看是哪个文件夹，不再悄悄消失。关联 #14627。
- 安装升级时 Studio 还在运行，安装程序会连同内核一起关掉，必要时请求一次管理员权限；仍关不掉就用中文说明怎么退出。修复 #14658 fixed in #14659。
- 设置里的「图形渲染」从「外观与主题」页移到「窗口与性能」页，和其他与占用相关的选项放在一起。修复 #14719 fixed in #14732。
- 普通目录会话不再显示顶部的「原目录」徽标，独立工作树统一显示「独立工作树」并补充目录说明。关联 #14619 by @SivanCola。

## 修复

- Windows 开启沙箱后 Git Bash 每条命令都报「couldn't create signal pipe」；现在 Git Bash 在沙箱下起不来时，会话自动改用 PowerShell 并说明原因。修复 #14713 fixed in #14735，关联 #14714。
- 设置里主按钮（编辑模型后的「保存」、「新建预设」、「加入 QQ 群」）的文字与底色几乎同色、看不清的问题。修复 #14679 fixed in #14733。
- 输入框下方的执行权限、模式、模型、强度菜单展开时，不再被上方的计划条盖住一截。修复 #14720 fixed in #14731。
- 对话里「执行过程」一行的字号与同级的「思考」一行统一。修复 #14682 fixed in #14686。
- 设置按钮高度对齐、重命名对话框字体统一，项目栏的「添加项目」在长列表滚动时保持可点。关联 #14600 fixed in #14708 by @lancy69、#14601 fixed in #14707 by @lancy69、#14607 fixed in #14709 by @lancy69。
- 恢复会话时，纯图片的一轮不再消失，终端会显示「附有 N 张图片」。关联 #14716 by @chuiwenwei。
- `reasonix doctor catalogs` 不再对记录过失败的目录打印 `ok`，而是显示 `failed` 或 `degraded`。关联 #14549 by @chuiwenwei。
- 会话租约无法证明时不再谎称被占用：密钥擦除拒绝改写并以错误退出，会话与任务列表显示 `unknown`。关联 #14727 by @chuiwenwei。
- 以 `..` 开头的根目录名现在按仓库内路径判断 gitignore。关联 #14734 by @kevin9327。
- 后台子任务的用量保留启动时的 Goal 归属，嵌套委派继承原归属；子任务恢复拒绝无法识别的持久化状态。关联 #14025。

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@lancy69、@SivanCola、@chuiwenwei、@kevin9327

---

<!-- lang:en -->

## New

- Appearance → Size → Line width has a custom percentage, 30–100% in 1% steps, applied to the transcript and composer together; the presets are unchanged. Refs #14649 fixed in #14667 by @lancy69.

## Changed

- The title block at the top of each settings page (section name and setting count) is gone; the navigation already shows where you are. Refs #14625.
- An installed program inside a project folder is listed in "Open with" as unavailable, with the reason and folder on hover, instead of silently missing. Refs #14627.
- During install or upgrade the installer closes a running Studio with its kernel, asks once for administrator permission if needed, and says how to quit by hand. Fixes #14658 fixed in #14659.
- "Graphics rendering" moves from the Appearance and theme page to the Window and performance page, next to the other options that affect resource use. Fixes #14719 fixed in #14732.
- Ordinary sessions no longer show the Local checkout header badge; isolated worktrees use one neutral label with explanatory tooltips. Refs #14619 by @SivanCola.

## Fixed

- With the Windows sandbox on, every Git Bash command failed; a sandboxed session now uses PowerShell and says why when Git Bash cannot start there. Fixes #14713 fixed in #14735, refs #14714.
- Primary buttons in Settings (Save after editing a model, New preset, Join the QQ group) no longer draw their label in almost the same colour as their fill. Fixes #14679 fixed in #14733.
- The permission, mode, model and effort menus under the composer are no longer partly covered by the plan bar above them. Fixes #14720 fixed in #14731.
- The "Execution" row in a conversation uses the same text size as the "Thinking" row at the same level. Fixes #14682 fixed in #14686.
- Settings button heights line up, the rename dialog uses the shared type styles, and the project header's Add project stays reachable while a long list scrolls. Refs #14600 fixed in #14708 by @lancy69, #14601 fixed in #14707 by @lancy69, #14607 fixed in #14709 by @lancy69.
- A restored transcript no longer drops a turn that was only an image; the terminal says "N image(s) attached". Refs #14716 by @chuiwenwei.
- `reasonix doctor catalogs` no longer prints `ok` for a catalog that recorded a failure; it reports `failed` or `degraded`. Refs #14549 by @chuiwenwei.
- When a session lease cannot be proven, the secret scrub refuses to rewrite and exits non-zero instead of claiming the lease is held; listings show `unknown`. Refs #14727 by @chuiwenwei.
- A root name starting with `..` is judged as inside the repository for gitignore. Refs #14734 by @kevin9327.
- Background children keep the Goal that started them for usage accounting, nested delegation inherits it, and subagent continuation refuses unrecognised persisted states. Refs #14025.

## Contributors

Thanks to this release's contributors: @lancy69, @SivanCola, @chuiwenwei, @kevin9327

## What's Changed
* feat(installer): close a running Studio thoroughly and say how when it cannot by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14659
* fix(doctor): a catalog that recorded a failure is not ok by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14549
* feat(proc): expose root wait completion / 区分根等待完成与取消返回 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14459
* feat(mutation): coordinate opaque writes across roots / 未知范围写入跨根互斥 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14446
* feat(isolation): prepare Store-owned candidates / 由结果 Store 统一准备候选 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14494
* fix(studio): clarify worktree labels and directory choices / 简化工作树标识并保留目录模式选择 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14619
* fix(deps): bump golang.org/x/net to v0.62.0 for GO-2026-6860 by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14685
* feat(openwith): say why an installed program is not offered by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14654
* feat(studio): add adjustable conversation viewport width by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14667
* fix: retain delegated Goal usage ownership / 保留委派任务的 Goal 用量归属 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14661
* fix(delegation): refuse unknown saved run states / 拒绝未知子任务恢复状态 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14656
* fix(studio): the Execution row uses the same text size as the Thinking row by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14686
* feat(desktop): drop the title block above each settings page by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14700
* fix(studio): composer menus open above the plan bar by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14731
* feat(studio): graphics rendering lives on the window and performance page by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14732
* fix(studio): align settings header button heights by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14707
* fix(studio): keep project controls outside the scrolling tree by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14708
* fix(studio): use semantic typography in session rename dialog by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14709

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 `.deb` 走自己的包（`.rpm` 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。
