name: v0.8.6
body:
### Added

- **Deferred audio generation (#2506).** Queue audio overviews with `later=True`
  in Python or `--later` in the CLI on Web and Android.

- **Deferred Studio generation (#2519).** Queue videos, reports (including study
  guides), quizzes, flashcards, infographics and slide decks with `later=True`
  in Python or `--later` in the CLI on Web and Android. Scheduled jobs return
  `scheduled`; combining `--later` with `--wait` is rejected. Cinematic video
  remains unsupported for deferred generation.

- **Experimental Android Live Voice (#2509).** Android clients can open
  notebook-bound `client.live.connect(...)` sessions with audio input/output,
  transcripts, interruption events and bounded lifecycle cleanup. Recording,
  playback and codecs remain application-owned; automatic reconnection is not enabled.

### Changed

- **The Windows CLI runs on asyncio's default event loop (#2485).** The
  `notebooklm` CLI no longer installs `WindowsSelectorEventLoopPolicy` at
  startup (#79). On CPython 3.12–3.14 that loop could drop chunks of large file
  uploads (`AssertionError: Data should not be empty`, then `NETWORK_ERROR …
  (upload_finalize)`), and it had already broken Playwright login (#89, #2011).
  Commands now use the Proactor loop, like `notebooklm-mcp`,
  `notebooklm-server` and the Python API. If commands hang inside a sandbox
  such as Sandboxie-Plus (#75), set `NOTEBOOKLM_WINDOWS_EVENT_LOOP=selector`;
  an unknown value fails before the command starts. On Python 3.11+ the CLI no
  longer uses the event-loop policy API that Python 3.16 removes,
  `login --master-token` now runs through the same loop selection, and the CLI
  hides curl_cffi's Proactor warning, whose advice to install the selector
  policy no longer applies.

### Fixed

- **Android owned notebooks can be removed from recent views without an error.**
  Google now returns `INVALID_ARGUMENT` for this no-op. The client verifies
  explicit ownership before accepting that response; failures for shared,
  missing, or unreadable notebooks still raise an error.

- **Fresh installs include `typing_extensions` (#2500).** Declare the runtime
  dependency used by public type exports.
- **Synchronous cookie recovery honors the selected transport (#2504).**
  Curl-backed recovery uses the supported curl_cffi runtime.
- Updated locked dependencies to address reported vulnerabilities (#2513).

- **An uppercase full UUID now reaches the right notebook, source, note or
  artifact.** The CLI and MCP resolvers passed a full UUID through in the case
  it was typed, but Google matches ids case-sensitively and its ids are always
  lowercase. Reads by an uppercase id failed with a misleading `NOT_FOUND`, and
  `notebook_delete` by one reported `deleted` while the notebook stayed. The
  resolvers now lowercase a full UUID before any backend call. The REST server,
  which takes ids as given in the path, is unchanged.

- **Windows CLI uploads on the selector loop no longer lose data (#2485).** On
  Python 3.12–3.14, asyncio's selector loop drops a chunk of the request body
  when a Windows socket send would block, so multi-megabyte uploads failed
  with a flood of `AssertionError: Data should not be empty` and left the
  source stuck in `preparing`. When `NOTEBOOKLM_WINDOWS_EVENT_LOOP=selector`
  selects that loop, the CLI now installs the fix from Python 3.15, only on
  interpreters that have the bug. The default Proactor loop, the Python API,
  `notebooklm-mcp` and `notebooklm-server` leave asyncio unpatched.
- **Android audio and video downloads no longer crawl at playback speed.** The
  media host, `googlevideo.com`, throttles a whole-file download to about
  32 KiB/s, so a 23-minute audio overview took roughly 12 minutes and often
  failed with `Android transfer failed (code=transport …)`. The Android backend
  now fetches that host in contiguous 8 MiB ranges, which arrive at full
  speed: the same 22.8 MB file downloads in about a second. Each range is
  checked against the previous one and the declared total, and a server that
  ignores the range is still read in full.
- **Title lookups now find `İstanbul` from `istanbul` (#2476).** MCP name
  resolution (notebooks, sources, notes, artifacts and Studio items) matches
  in tiers. Tier 1 is Unicode canonical caseless matching, so composed and
  decomposed spellings now agree. Only when tier 1 finds nothing does an
  accent-insensitive tier 2 run, and it raises an ambiguity error rather than
  pick between several titles. The near-miss hints and the download `--name`
  filter use the accent-insensitive key directly. Studio item refs gain the
  title-prefix matching the other resolvers already had for lookups and
  previews; `studio_rename` and a confirmed single-item `studio_delete` still
  need an exact title or an id, and a complete Studio listing for a title. Dotless `ı` still
  never matches `i`. The confirmation previews of `share_set_access`,
  `share_set_user` and `share_remove_user` now include the resolved notebook
  `title`, as `notebook_delete` already did, so a tier-2 match is visible
  before anything changes; if the notebook list cannot be read, the preview
  shows `title: null` instead of failing. These previews, and those of
  `notebook_delete` and a single-source `source_delete`, reuse the list read
  to resolve a name instead of listing again; the two delete previews also
  show `title: null` when a full-id preview cannot read the list (with a
  name, resolution fails first). Preview titles are now also found when the
  ref is a full id in uppercase. Tools that change data (renames,
  saves, adds, generation, research, chat settings, sharing changes, and
  confirmed deletes) use tier 1 only: a ref that only the accent-insensitive
  tier would match returns a `VALIDATION` error naming the candidates, where
  it was `NOT_FOUND` with a "Did you mean" hint before. Read-only tools and
  confirmation previews keep both tiers.

name: v0.21.40
body:
# oh-my-codex v0.21.40

`0.21.40` is a patch release that fixes OMX session-pointer ownership when a long-lived managed Codex app-server is running and improves tmux shim-log test reliability.

## Highlights

- **MANAGED CODEX SESSION POINTER OWNERSHIP (#3949; fixes #3946):** A verified `codex app-server --managed-daemon` process is no longer republished as the OMX session owner or allowed to block `omx resume` and fresh launches. `omx session pointer recover` and doctor provide a working recovery action. Live interactive OMX owners remain protected; unknown or mismatched process identity fails closed. Reported by @nascyimento.

## Fixes and compatibility

- No breaking API changes.
- Preserve completed, trailerless non-tail tmux shim-log records when command writes interleave; discard only an unfinished final segment (#3941). This is test-harness coverage, not a runtime behavior change.
- The release-train commits synchronize the package, npm lockfile, Cargo workspace/lockfile, and plugin metadata at `0.21.40` (#3943).

## Known issues and exclusions

- #3898 remains held for the owner design decision. Related PRs #3939, #3900, and #3907 remain excluded, as does held PR #3915.
- No other user-facing changes in the compare range are excluded.

## Validation

name: v0.21.39
body:
# oh-my-codex v0.21.39

`0.21.39` is a patch release that recognizes GPT-6.1 Terra in the known Codex model catalog and fixes canonical state-root publication for detached session leaders.

## Highlights

- **GPT-6.1 TERRA MODEL RECOGNITION (#3933):** Add `gpt-6.1-terra` to the known Codex model catalog and routing reference; explicit model strings and existing model defaults remain unchanged.
- **CANONICAL DETACHED-SESSION ROOTS (#3935):** Record the canonical state root held by the leader's binding so the strict reuse guard recognizes sessions started through an aliased or symlinked root.

## Fixes and compatibility

- No breaking API changes.
- Test harness reliability improved: per-file HOME isolation (#3936), VSCode log-write completion synchronization (#3937), and deterministic tmux/team fixture boundaries (#3938).

## Known issues and exclusions

- #3898 (live-pin fix) remains held for the owner design decision. On Codex 0.164.0, `.omx-live-pin` files in the plugin cache can invalidate hook approval; the workaround posted in #3898 disables the `oh-my-codex-local` plugin. name: v1.27.0-pre
body:
This week's release includes syntax highlighting for Go 1.27 generic methods, an option to open README files by default, and AI commit messages that follow your repository's recent commit style.

## Features

### AI

- Improved Agent Panel memory usage by loading tool-call diffs and parsing thread message Markdown only when first viewed, instead of when loading a thread. ([#65444](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65444), [#65470](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65470); thanks [Vanuan](https://github.com/Vanuan))
- Improved AI commit message generation by using the three most recent repository commit messages as style examples. ([#61528](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/61528); thanks [matheuslrd](https://github.com/matheuslrd))
- Improved CPU usage and disk reads while the agent was working, especially with a long thread history. ([#66015](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66015))

### Git

- Added missing tooltips to the close, commit message, and "View on" buttons in the Git Graph's commit details panel. ([#66016](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66016); thanks [skmanoj322](https://github.com/skmanoj322))
- Improved Git Graph rendering performance. ([#66180](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66180); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
- Improved the Git Panel's error message when a push was rejected because the local branch was behind the remote, explaining that remote changes must be fetched and integrated before pushing again. ([#47296](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47296); thanks [Aladiah96](https://github.com/Aladiah96))

### Languages

- Added syntax highlighting for Go 1.27 generic methods. ([#64562](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64562); thanks [ndellosa95](https://github.com/ndellosa95))

### Other

- Added an option to open README files by default by setting `on_new_window` to `"readme"`. ([#65389](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65389))
- Improved the Project Panel error message when moving a file or folder onto a location where one with the same name already existed. ([#64344](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64344); thanks [zaugust4891](https://github.com/zaugust4891))

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed Solargraph completions crashing Zed in certain cases. ([#66157](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66157))
- Fixed "Zed quit unexpectedly" appearing when quitting with `cmd-q` on macOS. ([#66158](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66158))
- Fixed a crash when adding surrounding characters (`m s`) to adjacent selections in Helix mode. ([#66107](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66107); thanks [bugprone](https://github.com/bugprone))
- Fixed child filesystem watches losing events when a covering parent watch was removed. ([#65998](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65998))
- Fixed collapsed inline diff hunks producing invalid word-diff highlights for multibyte UTF-8 text. ([#65829](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65829); thanks [Blazearth](https://github.com/Blazearth))
- Fixed external agents' tool call locations opening one line below the line the agent reported. ([#66110](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66110))
- Fixed file links with line numbers failing to open WSL files when using Zed on Windows. ([#66089](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66089); thanks [buvidk1234](https://github.com/buvidk1234))
- Fixed Git Graph rendering lagging behind when opening or closing the commit details panel. ([#66132](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66132); thanks [RemcoSmitsDev](https://github.com/RemcoSmitsDev))
- Fixed inline review switching to a subagent's edits when the subagent started. ([#66093](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66093))
- Fixed issues detecting local and remote environment variables when using PowerShell (`pwsh`). ([#66097](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66097))
- Fixed language server formatting requests sometimes applying incorrect changes. ([#65856](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65856))
- Fixed language server setup failing with `EBADDEVENGINES` in Yarn and pnpm projects. ([#65280](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65280); thanks [latin-1](https://github.com/latin-1))
- Fixed language servers receiving change and save notifications for files outside their dynamically registered document selectors, including unrelated files in the project. ([#65253](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65253); thanks [aviatesk](https://github.com/aviatesk))
- Fixed LLM credentials being read when `disable_ai` was set to `true`. ([#66029](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66029))
- Fixed missed filesystem events for case-insensitive watches registered with trailing separators or equivalent path spellings. ([#65995](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65995))
- Fixed missing Git repository, worktree, and branch names in the title bar for Windows remote projects opened in a repository subfolder. ([#66142](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66142); thanks [lingyaochu](https://github.com/lingyaochu))
- Fixed missing thinking output from OpenAI-compatible Responses endpoints that emitted reasoning-text events. ([#65938](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65938))
- Fixed on-type formatting after pressing `enter` being applied before the new line's indentation, which left the cursor after text inserted by language servers such as Ruby LSP. ([#65769](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65769); thanks [JacobNWolf](https://github.com/JacobNWolf))
- Fixed remote projects (SSH, WSL) becoming unresponsive when loading an agent thread that referred to many files outside the project. ([#65189](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65189); thanks [coinman-dev](https://github.com/coinman-dev))
- Fixed renaming files, creating files, and renaming terminal tabs being cancelled when `focus_follows_mouse` was enabled and the mouse moved. ([#66167](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66167))
- Fixed retryable provider failures in OpenAI-compatible chat streams not being recognized as retryable. ([#66038](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66038))
- Fixed right-click menus and popup pickers closing when the mouse moved to another pane with `focus_follows_mouse` enabled. ([#66173](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66173))
- Fixed sandboxed agent terminal commands incorrectly reporting failure under dash on Linux. ([#64439](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64439); thanks [NHendrickson9616](https://github.com/NHendrickson9616))
- Fixed SSH connections failing when usernames containing `/` or `\` were percent-encoded. ([#64744](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64744); thanks [ryanabx](https://github.com/ryanabx))
- Fixed status bar panel buttons doing nothing when another panel in the same dock was zoomed. ([#66119](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66119); thanks [ybelmach](https://github.com/ybelmach))
- Fixed streaming connection failures being classified as non-retryable errors for Google AI and OpenAI Responses model requests. ([#65940](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65940))
- Fixed the automatically installed Delve debugger for Go not updating after its initial installation. ([#66025](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66025))
- Fixed changes to `focus_follows_mouse` not applying to docks until Zed was restarted. ([#66161](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66161))
- Fixed deleted files remaining in the File Finder's history. ([#65660](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65660))
- Fixed duplicating files or folders in the Project Panel overwriting clipboard contents. ([#60894](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/60894); thanks [shindgew](https://github.com/shindgew))
- Fixed external stash renames not being reflected in the stash picker. ([#55294](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/55294))
- Fixed failed model-list fetches, such as those caused by invalid or expired API keys, being silently dropped instead of logged for Anthropic, Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, OpenRouter, and Vercel AI Gateway. ([#64171](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64171); thanks [somtri](https://github.com/somtri))
- Fixed language servers' dynamically registered capabilities applying to files outside their document selector's `pattern`. ([#65252](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65252); thanks [aviatesk](https://github.com/aviatesk))
- Fixed long recent project names and the Open Project shortcut overflowing on the Welcome screen and in narrow panels. ([#65531](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65531); thanks [junkmailkeep](https://github.com/junkmailkeep))
- Fixed pasting in Helix select mode with `shift-r`, `space p`, or `cmd-v` not returning to normal mode. ([#65492](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65492); thanks [raum-dellamorte](https://github.com/raum-dellamorte))
- Fixed project entries reappearing in Recent Projects after removal. ([#66127](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66127); thanks [EcutAtom336](https://github.com/EcutAtom336))
- Fixed project names in the title bar for `repo.git` bare clones on remote Windows hosts. ([#66199](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66199); thanks [lingyaochu](https://github.com/lingyaochu))
- Fixed reordering a Markdown editor tab switching back to Markdown preview when "Open Markdown Files in Preview" was enabled. ([#65795](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65795); thanks [mateioprea](https://github.com/mateioprea))
- Fixed running Go tests on Windows failing with an invalid-directory error. ([#65722](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65722); thanks [giocld](https://github.com/giocld))
- Fixed scrollbar settings not applying to already open terminals, panels, and menus until they were reopened. ([#66017](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66017))
- Fixed unnecessary-code dimming sometimes disappearing when `code_lens` and `semantic_tokens: "full"` were both enabled. ([#56003](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/56003))

## Breaking Changes and Notices

- Removed support for macOS Catalina and Big Sur. Zed now requires macOS 12.0 (Monterey) or later. ([#65994](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65994))
- Removed agent checkpoints and the "Restore Checkpoint" button. Taking a checkpoint before every message made the agent slow to respond, or hang, in large Git repositories. To undo the agent's changes, reject its edits or use Git. ([#65989](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65989))

name: v1.26.2
body:
This week's release includes Pyrefly as an optional built-in Python language server, the ability to expand and inspect nested variable values directly in debugger hovers, and DWARF debugging for WebAssembly sources in the JavaScript debugger.

## Features

### AI

- Improved ACP configuration defaults to apply only to new conversations, preserving session settings when reopening existing conversations. ([#65850](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65850))
- Improved fuzzy searching in agent model and configuration option pickers for Zed Agent and third-party ACP agents, while keeping search preparation off the UI thread. ([#64147](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64147); thanks [JacobNWolf](https://github.com/JacobNWolf))
- Improved OpenCode compatibility when replaying DeepSeek reasoning and disabling thinking for Google models. ([#65922](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65922))
- Improved thinking controls to explain when thinking cannot be disabled at the selected effort level. ([#62480](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/62480))

### Debugger

- Added DWARF debugging to the JavaScript debugger to support debugging WebAssembly sources. ([#65371](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65371); thanks [SGumbles](https://github.com/SGumbles))
- Improved debugger hovers with an expandable, keyboard-accessible variable tree. ([#53198](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/53198); thanks [Tortes](https://github.com/Tortes))

### Languages

- Added Pyrefly as an optional built-in Python language server, available when enabled in the Python `language_servers` setting. ([#44262](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44262); thanks [grievejia](https://github.com/grievejia))
- Improved restarting language servers after stopping them with the LSP button. ([#65387](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65387))
- Improved SQL syntax highlighting in Rust `sql!` string literals. ([#58778](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/58778); thanks [kuskhan](https://github.com/kuskhan))

### Remote Development

- Improved SSH reconnections by starting the resync timeout only after the handshake completes. ([#65457](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65457); thanks [Huliiiiii](https://github.com/Huliiiiii))

### macOS

- Added support for the Display P3 color space on macOS with the `use_display_p3` setting. ([#64394](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64394); thanks [MDalstrom](https://github.com/MDalstrom))

### Other

- Added an `extension` option to `project_panel.sort_order` to group files by extension. ([#65776](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65776); thanks [Carnage725](https://github.com/Carnage725))
- Improved fuzzy search ranking in the File Finder. ([#59224](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/59224); thanks [feitreim](https://github.com/feitreim))

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed discarding unstaged changes in the Git Panel also discarding staged changes. ([#65559](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65559); thanks [stezu](https://github.com/stezu))
- Fixed hangs when restoring agent threads with subagents. ([#65177](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65177))
- Fixed a crash in the Agent Panel when mentioning a file whose name contains a line break, and improved how those mentions display line breaks. ([#65693](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65693))
- Fixed a bug where cancelling the save-changes prompt while removing a project from the sidebar still removed it from the recent projects list. ([#65683](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65683); thanks [mateioprea](https://github.com/mateioprea))
- Fixed agent authentication overwriting drafts. ([#65844](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65844))
- Fixed agent configuration defaults being saved before acceptance or ignoring the agent's returned value. ([#65849](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65849))
- Fixed duplicated thinking text from OpenAI-compatible providers that send both `reasoning` and `reasoning_content`. ([#65926](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65926))
- Fixed file links with line numbers failing to open WSL files when using Zed on Windows. ([#66089](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66089); thanks [buvidk1234](https://github.com/buvidk1234))
- Fixed file icons not appearing for stem-based filename variants. ([#51891](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/51891); thanks [bryanpth](https://github.com/bryanpth))
- Fixed Google AI invalid API keys being classified as invalid requests instead of authentication errors. ([#65885](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65885))
- Fixed IME composition text not being underlined in single-line inputs and editors with diagnostics turned off. ([#65610](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65610); thanks [Sha1rholder](https://github.com/Sha1rholder))
- Fixed issues detecting local and remote environment variables when using PowerShell (`pwsh`). ([#66097](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/66097))
- Fixed JSON completion ordering for enum values in `settings.json`. ([#65589](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65589); thanks [ragen1337](https://github.com/ragen1337))
- Fixed Markdown preview tabs for files with the same name not showing their directory. ([#65736](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65736); thanks [gitKashish](https://github.com/gitKashish))
- Fixed Mistral Large 4 responses failing when used through an OpenAI-compatible provider. ([#65915](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65915))
- Fixed OpenCode requests failing for Claude models that use adaptive thinking block binding. ([#65925](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65925))
- Fixed pasting a screenshot into the Agent Panel or inline assistant inserting the image twice or alongside its temporary file path. ([#65626](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65626); thanks [qystishere](https://github.com/qystishere))
- Fixed queued messages in the Agent Panel becoming unreadable when the panel was narrow. ([#65638](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65638); thanks [0froq](https://github.com/0froq))
- Fixed Rust task and debugger variables for files outside Cargo projects. ([#65684](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/65684); thanks [shoyann](https://github.com/shoyann))
- Fixed touchscreen scrolling using the previous swipe's axis when a new touch interrupts momentum scrolling. ([#64239](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/64239); thanks [huacnlee](https://github.com/huacnlee))
- Fixed trusting projects on remote Windows machines from Unix systems. ([#63102](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/63102); thanks [lingyaochu](https://github.com/lingyaochu))

name: v5.1.51
body:
5.1.49 and 5.1.50 were not published; their changes ship here. Session startup and task RPC attachment no longer wait for task-host liveness probes. Recovery runs independently per host, stops claiming or reviving children after shutdown, and preserves newer ownership claims. ([#11335](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11335)) DAG recovery and workpool reconciliation now wait for that same session-start reconcile (one shared gate) without holding admission, so a paused DAG's revivable child is never judged orphaned and a queued workpool item of an orphaned worker is redelivered rather than marked delivery_uncertain. ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) Continuing a synchronous task whose session was already deleted now fails at once with an error saying to start a new task, instead of waiting out the 30-minute sync poll timeout; a sync poll also stops when the server keeps reporting its session as not found. Completed sync task sessions now honor `background_task.taskCleanupDelayMs` instead of a fixed 10 minutes. Reported by @orgito. ([#11524](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11524), fixes [#11520](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11520)) **omo.dev deploys again after the document-shell change.** The `/design` showcase became a root layout of its own and lost the hourly revalidation it used to inherit, so one prerendered page had no expiry and the deploy's asset-retention check refused the build. The design layout revalidates hourly again, within the site's one-hour HTML lifetime. ([#11587](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11587), fixes [#11585](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11585)) Release pull requests no longer fail the changelog gate when fragments for the next release land on the base branch after the cut. ([#11574](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11574)) - Release preparation no longer fails its own command-string audit when changelog fragments have been folded into the changelog. ([#11562](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11562)) **The frontend skill now builds in ten habits that design reviewers check for.** Before designing a new screen, a redesign, or a design system, it reads the guideline source in full, defines the ideal state per persona and journey step, and records every gap in a ledger. Controls keep the same box size in every state, and a spinner or arrow never adds padding. Pointer targets are at least 24 px, colour roles come before components (built from shadcn/ui anatomy), glass and dated trend surfaces stay out unless the brief asks for them, and the subtract pass counts the controls. Every UI or design-system deliverable states a per-criterion WCAG 2.2 AA result. ([#11536](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11536), fixes [#11534](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11534)) **macOS computer use releases the keys and buttons it holds even if the engine dies mid-call.** An input request that presses now starts the engine binary again as a hidden release helper and streams every press, drag move and release to it; when the engine is killed, crashes or a request unwinds with something still held, the helper posts the releases (within 2 seconds) through the same routes, leaving any key or button the user is physically holding to the user. The helper runs in its own session, ignores the hangup and terminate a group kill sends until its releases are out, and refuses to run unless the engine that spawned it is its parent and the stream carries its per-spawn token. Other platforms are unchanged. ([#11535](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11535)) **A process child whose provider has no usable sign-in now moves on to the next provider instead of failing.** When the engine refuses a child's first prompt with `provider_credentials_missing` or `provider_credentials_expired`, the task skips the remaining models on that provider and starts on the next provider in its fallback chain, ending on the parent session's model when nothing else is left. Each hop is recorded as a `task_model_fallback` event naming the provider. An engine that does not send these codes behaves exactly as before. Every other refused first prompt in process mode now also carries the engine's validated error code as `cause_code` in its `task_start_failed` event and in the start-failure message (for example `host_refused: host_memory_pressure`); this is diagnostic only and does not change what the task does. ([#11440](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11440), part of [#10806](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10806)) ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) **A queued steer to a subagent keeps its own id across the child boundary, and a lost acknowledgment is checked before anything is sent again.** A message queued for a child that is still starting reaches it under the id it was queued with, so a drain repeated after a restart replays instead of delivering a second copy. When the child's acknowledgment is lost, omo asks the child whether it holds that id (`get_pending_inputs`): held settles it, not held resends the same id, and an unreadable answer keeps it uncertain instead of guessing. ([#11427](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11427), part of [sisyphuslabs/omo-desktop-app#2838](https://github.com/sisyphuslabs/omo-desktop-app/issues/2838)) ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) **Model-profile notices no longer reach the model.** A notice such as "model profile ... has no available model" was sent as part of the conversation, so the model read it ahead of your first message, and on a slow start it could cost an extra model request. The notice now stays out of the conversation: when there is something to do, the desktop app shows it as a notice with the next step (sign in from Provider authentication settings, or choose a model in the composer), and a headless run logs it. ([#11365](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11365)) A stored login that failed while a working provider was used instead still reaches you as a notice naming the provider to re-authenticate, and a profile model the registry no longer finds is reported with the step to choose another model. ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) **Memory read grants now check the file a raw-string tool actually opens.** Containment follows native filesystem traversal before normalizing paths, so a directory symlink followed by `..` cannot redirect a project-memory grant to another identity. Built-in tools retain their resolved-path behavior, missing notes remain readable through their existing canonical ancestor, and case aliases of the same directory remain accepted. ([#11339](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11339)) ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) **Completed Momus review verdicts are now persisted as numbered Markdown artifacts next to the plan file.** Each `.omo/plans/{plan}.reviews/NNN-okay.md` or `NNN-reject.md` artifact captures the verdict, timestamp, model, plan sha256, review duration, reviewer session id, and the verdict block (the reasoning that precedes the verdict is not stored), so a finished review survives the end of the session. A `.gitignore` written next to the plans keeps the `.reviews` directories out of the user's own staging area. Momus itself stays read-only; persistence happens entirely on the orchestrator side after the review result returns. ([#11237](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11237), fixes [#3002](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/3002)) Thanks to [@surlymochan](https://github.com/surlymochan) for this contribution. ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) **Release binaries may be up to 200 MiB, and 5.1.49 was not published.** omo 5.1.49's Linux binaries came out over the 182 MiB size budget (linux-x64 200.0 MB, linux-arm64 198.2 MB), so that release stopped before anything was published. The growth is the Bun 1.4.4 runtime itself: an empty compiled Bun program grew from 90.8 MB to 109.1 MB between Bun 1.4.3 and 1.4.4, while everything omo added since 5.1.48 is about 0.46 MB. The budget moves from 182 MiB to 200 MiB so releases keep shipping the Bun version CI tests. ([#11491](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11491)) ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) **Every omo.dev page now declares its own language and the dark colour scheme, and starts with a skip link.** Korean, Japanese, Chinese and the other locales set `` to their language (it was always English), form controls and scrollbars render dark, the first Tab offers "Skip to content", focused controls no longer hide under the sticky header, and unknown pages show a 404 in the reader's language. ([#11498](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11498)) **The omo.dev docs search box has a visible edge and a real label.** Its border now meets the 3:1 contrast floor (it was 1.2:1), screen readers announce it as "Filter documentation sections" instead of its placeholder, and the section list has its own name. ([#11492](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11492)) **Icon buttons on omo.dev show their label on keyboard focus, and Escape closes the mobile menu.** The workflow graph's Fit and Center buttons get a real tooltip (shown on hover and focus, dismissed with Escape), and Escape closes the mobile navigation sheet and puts focus back on the menu button. ([#11490](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11490)) **Dimmed graph nodes and quiet labels on omo.dev are readable again.** Nodes off the highlighted path in the workflow graph recede by colour instead of fading to 20% (text contrast goes from 1.1:1 to 5.8:1), and step numbers and the corrected word in the demo no longer use the decoration-only grey. ([#11488](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11488)) **The opencode edition's skill tool no longer repeats skill descriptions OpenCode already lists.** A skill is left out of the skill tool's item list only when OpenCode core's own skill list has the same skill (same name, same file) with a description, so its description is sent once per request instead of twice. Skills core does not list (flat `.md` skills, skills without a name or description, skills core skips because of its disable flags or a custom Claude config dir, OMO-bundled skills) stay in the skill tool's list, and when core's list cannot be read nothing is left out. ([#11456](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11456)) **The provider sign-in page shows the OmO logo.** Every omo launch path (npm, the compiled binary, the local launcher) hands the engine the OmO icon with its brand, so the page a browser shows after signing in to a provider can carry the OmO mark instead of only the name. The logo appears only once omo pins a senpi release that includes senpi#4432/#4434; the currently pinned senpi (2026.10.27-1) ignores it. ([#11445](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11445), fixes [#11444](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11444)) **Release preparation no longer fails its own tests.** The changelog stamp-agreement test read `changes/unreleased` unconditionally; a release-state tree has consumed every fragment and has no such directory, so the test crashed on every release PR. It now reads the real fragments only when the directory exists. ([#11443](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11443)) **LazyCodex bug-fix skills now send fixes to the repository that owns the source.** `lcx-contribute-bug-fix` told agents that a LazyCodex-owned defect must become a verified-fix issue carrying the patch on the `code-yeongyu/lazycodex` mirror, so a fix that already sat as an open lead PR here was filed a second time as a full diff on the mirror. The skill now searches the author's own open PRs across repos first, then opens a fork PR against `code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent` (base `dev`, `packages/omo-codex/plugin/...` paths, changelog fragment); the mirror gets no PR and at most a short issue that links it. `lcx-report-bug` routes fixes the same way. Upstream `openai/codex` routing is unchanged. ([#11410](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11410)) **Research fact locators now bind to original snapshot bytes.** Source snapshots retain the fetched bytes as `raw.bin`; a `--text` file alone becomes a converted-only source that supports warned quotations but no measured rows, and `--raw --text ` keeps the original next to a declared extraction. Page locators read only reader-visible text nodes (never attributes, scripts, styles, or hidden elements), record byte offsets in the source's own encoding, and `fact verify` fails closed when a cited snapshot cannot be read. The new `source refresh` command repins a re-fetched source and re-anchors its rows by quote and context; a legacy row on a refreshed source is listed as not re-anchored and blocks verification instead of passing unchecked. ([#11287](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11287)) **Research collection now catches numbers that text conversion changed, and refuses to register them.** `source probe-conversion` compares numeric multisets with one grouped-number grammar (a footnote digit glued onto `12,345` is reported; a lone `1.234` is a decimal), never groups digits across a table cell, row, list item or line break, lets digits copied from link targets, image sources, alt text and titles cover only numbers inside Markdown link or image syntax, treats a converter's ordered-list markers (only where the source has that `
    ` item, lazy `1. 1. 1.` numbering included), numeric reference-link labels, footnote-definition labels and hard-wrapped digit groups as conversion syntax rather than numbers, reads a sign through the emphasis, code, titled-link, image and escape markup a converter adds (`**2019**-2023` is a range), decodes named references with one table on both sides (`−`, ` `), reads the raw inline HTML a converter keeps (`10-5`, a sized ``) as the source's own tags, accepts a reference title on the next line, and counts a minus touching Korean text, a single letter or an exponent, or written as an en dash. `source snapshot` prints the altered numbers, and `fact add` refuses a value its source's conversion altered with `conversion_altered_number`; the recovery is `source snapshot --id S --text --replace`, refused while an active row cites the source. The fact-ledger reference declares the probe's guaranteed scope and lists what is out of scope (shortcodes, LaTeX, non-CommonMark tables), which always reports as altered. Both research editions describe this flow; their existing phase instructions now live in focused references. ([#11286](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11286)) **Skill MCP clients can use MCP 2026-07-28 servers.** Modern servers receive discovery and per-request protocol metadata without an initialization handshake. Input-required operations stop with a clear error because skill MCP does not support elicitation. Legacy servers receive a discovery probe before their existing initialization negotiation; a timed-out probe logs the fallback and is paid only once per server per process, because later connects to that server go straight to legacy initialization (a failed legacy initialization forgets it), and unsupported-version fallback preserves the legacy server's capabilities and identity. ([#11243](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11243), part of [#11205](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11205)) **The desktop-engine MCP server also serves MCP 2026-07-28 clients.** Discovery and per-request protocol metadata work without initialization; modern results identify the server and complete result type, and tool lists include cache hints. Unsupported request versions are rejected before daemon access, notifications receive no reply, and legacy initialization keeps its existing supported-version negotiation. ([#11239](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11239), part of [#11205](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11205)) ### Fixed - Atlas schedules its delayed boulder-continuation retry through an injectable scheduler (default: the real timer), and its tests drive that scheduler instead of patching global timers, so a whole-suite run no longer fires other modules' timers in the retry tests ([#11619](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11619), fixes [#11617](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11617)) - Cancelling a prompt now stops an in-flight skill MCP call: `skill_mcp` passes the session abort signal to the MCP request, which rejects at once with the abort reason, and an HTTP MCP server's request and SSE stream are closed instead of staying open until the connection is torn down ([#11592](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11592)) - The Prometheus planning-file guard resolves Windows paths the way the executor opens them: both `/` and `\` split the physical walk, so a `link/..` spelling is followed through the link instead of being collapsed lexically (a symlink escape was allowed), a symlinked or junctioned planning directory such as `.omo -> docs\plans` is recognised again, and 8.3 short names, drive-letter case and directory case all resolve to one canonical path. Inside-planning checks compare the canonical paths exactly, which keeps case-variant entries on case-sensitive directories distinct ([#11548](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11548)) - A ChatGPT subscription whose sign-in refresh fails only briefly at session start (connection refused, timeout, a 408/429/5xx from the token endpoint) now stays selected in the model profile. Before, the session moved to the next provider, for example a configured OpenAI API key, and stayed on that metered lane until it was restarted. A refused refresh still skips the provider with the re-authenticate notice, a credential failure seen while re-checking the model still skips the provider with the matching notice, a model whose own request headers fail to resolve is still skipped, and a candidate kept while its refresh is still unresolved logs one warning with the error class and transport code so a later first-turn failure can be traced ([#11442](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11442), fixes [#11432](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11432)) ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) - `omo logout` now leaves a small sign-out note (no credentials, just the device and the time), so OmO Desktop can tell a deliberate sign-out from a credential store that hasn't answered yet. `omo account token` and `export` report it with exit code 10; exit 4 still means nothing could be read. Signing in again removes the note. The note is written before the credentials are removed, so a failed write leaves you signed in and `omo logout` reports the error; a damaged note is ignored (exit 4) and never breaks `omo account show`. ([#11441](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11441), fixes [#11434](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/11434)) ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) - A workflow (DAG) category node whose whole model chain is spent or signed out now finishes on the parent session's model, the same last rung a `task` child gets. The model is captured when the workflow starts and kept on the run, so retried and recovered nodes keep it too. ([#11439](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11439)) ([#11525](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11525)) - Prometheus checks and executes the same authorized planning-file path, including relative symlink/`..` paths, aliased project roots, hashline renames, and patch moves. Patch headers must round-trip through the supported executor parser without changing authorized operations or targets. Rename/delete preserve named final links; content writes follow only allowed targets. The physical planning directory may have any name the user chose (for example `.omo -> docs/plans`) but must be strictly inside the real project root, never the root itself or an ancestor; a `.omo` path segment matches with filesystem-native casing. Every denial is logged with its specific reason. Nested plans and parent-folder Windows paths remain supported; required argument rewrites fail closed if the host's retained arguments cannot receive them ([#11424](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/11424)) - Bundled skills no longer ship a top-level `__tests__` or `*_test` folder. Only a skill's top-level `test/` and `tests/` folders are exempt from the test-folder filter; before, any top-level folder name escaped it. name: v2.2.1
body:
### Highlights

- **Keep Working Toward a Goal**: Run `/goal <objective>` in the TUI or Desktop to let the session continue until a reviewer confirms the objective is met. Use `/goal pause`, `/goal resume`, or `/goal clear` to control it. ([#59437](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59437))
- **Generate Images**: Enable `experimental.image_generate` to let agents create or edit images with the new `image_generate` tool. You can optionally set its default model with `experimental.image_generate.model`. ([#59939](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59939), [#60096](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60096))
- **Inspect Background Shells**: Click a running shell in the Desktop activity pill to see its live output and stop it without leaving the menu. ([#59496](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59496))
- **New Default Model Picker**: Search favorites, recent models, providers, and variants from the redesigned model picker, which is now the default in Desktop. ([#59997](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59997))

### Breaking changes

#### `@opencode/ai` provider removals and renames

These changes affect code that imports `@opencode/ai` directly. They don't change the CLI, Desktop, or the HTTP API.

- The fal, Black Forest Labs, Replicate, and Stability providers are removed, along with their `./providers/fal`, `./providers/black-forest-labs`, `./providers/replicate`, and `./providers/stability` entry points. ([#59977](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59977))
- Five legacy entry points are removed. Import the nested paths instead, which 2.2.0 already exports: `./providers/amazon-bedrock-mantle` → `./providers/amazon-bedrock/mantle`, and `./providers/google-vertex-chat`, `-interactions`, `-mistral`, and `-responses` → `./providers/google-vertex/chat`, `/interactions`, `/mistral`, and `/responses`. ([#59506](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59506))
- Each provider's `configure()` input type is now named `Config`, for example `Groq.LanguageModelOptions` → `Groq.Config`, and `model()` settings are optional when every setting is optional. ([#59765](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59765))

### Core

#### Improvements

- Add `/goal <objective>` with pause, resume, and clear controls, plus automatic progress review until the objective is met. ([#59437](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59437))
- Add opt-in scheduled prompts through `/schedule`, agent tools, and `experimental.schedules`. ([#59401](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59401), [#59457](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59457))
- Add the opt-in `image_generate` tool for background image creation and editing, with automatic or configured model selection. ([#59939](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59939), [#60096](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60096))
- Offer GPT Image 2 after Codex sign-in and add MiniMax and Meta Muse image generation support. ([#60085](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60085), [#59929](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59929), [#60081](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60081))
- Add Responses API support for OpenRouter, DigitalOcean, and Venice, including freeform tools. ([#59991](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59991), [#59963](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59963))
- Improve snapshot performance by coalescing captures and avoiding repeated ignore-file work. ([#59419](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59419))

#### Bug fixes

- Preserve more context headroom when fitting tool output into the context window. ([#59934](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59934))
- Retry provider throttling correctly instead of reporting it as context overflow. ([#59649](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59649))
- Send image-edit references and image sizes in the formats expected by OpenRouter, Google, and Vercel Grok. ([#60067](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60067), [#59927](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59927))
- Keep credential metadata and prompt-cache settings out of model settings and variants. ([#60057](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60057), [#59500](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59500))
- Keep Git snapshots working in repositories that use a split index. ([#59417](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59417))
- Expose Console web search only when the workspace enables it. ([#59592](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59592))
- Improve Code Mode diagnostics for parse errors, stalled awaits, and promise-like search results. ([#59834](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59834), [#59749](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59749), [#59981](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59981))

### TUI

#### Improvements

- Show `/goal` status below the prompt and provide a dialog for pausing, resuming, or clearing it. ([#59437](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59437))

#### Bug fixes

- Show execution failures that occur before the first model step. ([#60079](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60079))
- Keep the activity spinner visible while a continued subagent runs. ([#59950](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59950))
- Send pasted image and PDF paths correctly when connected to a local server. ([#59833](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59833))
- Improve spacing in an empty `/usage` dialog. Thanks [@Tarquinen](https://github.com/Tarquinen). ([#59918](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59918))

### Desktop

#### Improvements

- Add `/reload` to reload configuration without restarting. ([#59887](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59887))
- Make the redesigned searchable model picker the default, with dedicated Favorites and Recent sections and keyboard-accessible provider controls. ([#59997](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59997))
- Show live output and a Stop action when you select a background shell from the activity pill. ([#59496](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59496))
- Show `/goal` state and actions in a composer pill. ([#59437](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59437))
- Redesign the integrations dialog and always include OpenCode free models in the model picker. ([#59976](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59976), [#60047](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60047))
- Add project, worktree, open-in-app, and terminal actions to the session location menu. ([#59607](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59607))
- Refine project and worktree selection, command search, prompt-history focus, composer model labels, and artifact preview controls. ([#59397](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59397), [#59604](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59604), [#59626](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59626), [#59735](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59735), [#59657](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59657))
- Highlight quoted timeline content while you write its first comment. ([#59286](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59286))
- Keep draft attachment bytes local when using experimental media URIs. ([#59104](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59104))

#### Bug fixes

- Follow each plugin server’s configured endpoint when connecting to its event stream. ([#60087](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60087))
- Treat the reachable scroll boundary as the end when Desktop zoom is active. ([#60034](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60034))
- Prevent shell text from showing through copy buttons and avoid restyling the transcript when closing a side panel. ([#59901](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59901), [#59878](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59878))
- Keep rendering malformed tool metadata instead of crashing the timeline. ([#59736](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59736))
- Make dropdowns open immediately and keep the new-session location shortcut working after tooltip interactions. ([#59268](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59268), [#59680](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59680))
- Remove edge halos from macOS application icons. ([#59900](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59900))

### SDK

#### Improvements

- Add `client.experimental.schedule.{create,list,get,pause,resume,delete}` for managing scheduled prompts. ([#59457](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59457))
- Group experimental generated-client methods under `client.experimental`; previous locations remain as deprecated aliases until the next minor release. ([#59072](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59072))
- Expose compaction through the Promise AI client. ([#59987](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59987))
- Add freeform tool support and Responses routes for OpenRouter, DigitalOcean, and Venice. ([#59963](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59963), [#59991](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59991))

### Extensions

#### Improvements

- Add the experimental `experimental.idle` Session hook so plugins can continue work before a session goes idle. ([#59437](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59437))
- Let Code Mode extension globals return Effects and declare required services. ([#59948](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59948))
- Add custom composer-pill popovers for GUI plugins. ([#59437](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59437))
